about_the_game:
The Monster Con is back in town! Put on your favorite cosplay and grab your autograph book, because you’re going back to the craziest convention ever… with 2 brand new playable characters to choose from!

  • It was about time Sadie, our 24/7-stressed pizza girl, got some respite. Today's the day! She's taken a couple sick days off from her dozen-something jobs, and she's ready to have some much-needed me time. If you know the terrible misadventure that's being overworked by late stage Capitalism (said the marketing text, haha, I wanna cry), then this is a character you can relate to. Become Sadie in her biggest moment yet: the time she said "no" to working and "yes" to having fun.

  • But Sadie is not alone: she's back with another "Monster Camp" fellow: Moss Mann. This moth person is all about gossip... but what better way of getting all that juicy gossip than being in the eye of the hurricane? Moss is ready to leave the NPC life and become a fully playable character, excited to live all sorts of gossip-producing situations firsthand. So, if you aim to live a life worth a thousand anecdotes, this might be the character for you!

Get ready to nerd out with hot monsters... and be a hot, nerdy monster yourself!

content_descriptors.notes: Use of mature language in a humorous way.
